segments.title: New TrainerPage and requireTrainerId, modified router

traceDiagram.title: Open trainer and next trainer flow diagram
traceDiagram.description: This diagram shows how the router checks the id of `/trainers/:id` and renders the trainer page, which loads the trainer of that id. It also shows what happens when the user clicks Next trainer, and how the next id reaches the router through `router.push()`.

traceNodes.label: Renders a button that emits click
traceNodes.description: When TrainerPage renders, [it renders this button](code:src/views/trainers/TrainerPage.vue#L34) with the text Next trainer.

traceNodes.label: Matches a path to its page and its guard
traceNodes.description: When a user opens a URL of the app, Vue Router matches its path against these routes. For `/trainers/:id`, [the route names `requireTrainerId` and `TrainerPage`](code:src/router.ts#L23).

blockLabels.label: Lists the page of each path
Checks the trainer id before TrainerPage opens

traceNodes.label: Shows one trainer and a button to the next one
traceNodes.description: When a user opens `/trainers/:id` with a positive integer id, [Vue Router renders this page](code:src/router.ts#L23) inside RootLayout.

blockLabels.label: Gets the router that opens other pages
Reads the trainer id from the path
Loads the trainer at once and after each new id

traceNodes.label: Sends a path with a bad trainer id back to `/`
traceNodes.description: When a user opens `/trainers/:id`, [Vue Router calls this guard](code:src/router.ts#L23) before it renders TrainerPage.

blockLabels.label: Reads the id of the path as a number
Checks whether the id is a positive integer

traceNodes.label: Emits click to the component that renders the button
traceNodes.description: When a user clicks the `<button>`, Vue runs this handler, and [TrainerPage receives `click`](code:src/views/trainers/TrainerPage.vue#L34).

traceNodes.label: Loads the trainer again each time the id of the path changes
traceNodes.description: When TrainerPage renders, [Vue runs this watch at once](code:src/views/trainers/TrainerPage.vue#L18). Vue runs it again when `trainerId` changes, such as after a click on Next trainer.

blockLabels.label: Watches the trainer id of the path
Loads the trainer of the new id
Runs the load once when the page opens

traceNodes.label: Opens the page of the next trainer
traceNodes.description: When a user clicks Next trainer, [BaseButton emits `click`](code:src/components/ui/BaseButton.vue#L7), and Vue calls [`openNextTrainer()`](code:src/views/trainers/TrainerPage.vue#L21-23).

blockLabels.label: Pushes the path of the trainer with the next id

traceNodes.label: Requests the trainer of the id and stores it
traceNodes.description: When the watch sees a new `trainerId`, Vue calls this function with the id, and [the function requests `/trainers/:id` through `request()`](code:src/views/trainers/TrainerPage.vue#L16).
